decisions.reason: As a core extension of the firm's office systems that fits flexible workplace demand, its continued survival after the first review suggests performance is at or near aspiration and does not warrant reallocating resources away from it.

The high standing table remains a close, low-complexity complement to the firm's workplace and conference range, so with some organizational slack management would likely retain it unless recent results clearly fell short of aspiration.

Although more distant from the legacy furniture offer, the rug collection was framed as a flagship direction and its survival past the initial years indicates strategic commitment strong enough to tolerate moderate uncertainty rather than trigger withdrawal now.
